title: Mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='28' y='10' width='44' height='80' rx='9' ry='9' fill='#3a4a8a'/>
  <!-- phone body highlighted edge -->
  <rect x='28' y='10' width='44' height='80' rx='9' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#6a7bc4' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- screen -->
  <rect x='33' y='22' width='34' height='54' rx='3' ry='3' fill='#1a2a5a'/>
  <!-- screen glow border -->
  <rect x='33' y='22' width='34' height='54' rx='3' ry='3' fill='none' stroke='#5a7ae0' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- screen content: cute face -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='43' cy='42' r='3' fill='#7ef0ff'/>
  <circle cx='57' cy='42' r='3' fill='#7ef0ff'/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='41' r='1' fill='#c8ffff'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='41' r='1' fill='#c8ffff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M43 52 Q50 60 57 52' fill='none' stroke='#7ef0ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screen bottom dots -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#4a6ac0'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#4a6ac0'/>
  <circle cx='53' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#4a6ac0'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='66' r='1.5' fill='#4a6ac0'/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='4' fill='#2a3a7a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='84' r='2.5' fill='#5a7ae0'/>
  <!-- speaker slot -->
  <rect x='44' y='13' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2a3a7a'/>
  <!-- side button -->
  <rect x='72' y='35' width='3' height='10' rx='1.5' fill='#5a7ae0'/>
  <!-- volume buttons -->
  <rect x='25' y='30' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#5a7ae0'/>
  <rect x='25' y='41' width='3' height='7' rx='1.5' fill='#5a7ae0'/>
  <!-- camera dot top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='18' r='1.2' fill='#7ef0ff'/>
  <!-- little antenna heart on screen corner -->
  <path d='M62 27 Q64 24 66 27 Q64 30 62 27 Z' fill='#ff7eb0'/>
</svg>
